One of the finest hospitality arrangements I have ever seen. This review is for anyone or everyone who plan to have a wedding reception at this place for a crowd between 150 to 250

1. Ambience: Awesome, the hall was just setup to have a great reception with family and friends.
2. Decoration: Top notch. Starting from the idea, color combinations, the quantity, lightings, cut out designs all of them were to the T and accurate.
3. Food: The veg and the non-veg was top quality, it was served at the perfect temperature, the taste was the same that was approved. Almost every guest I spoke to had something unique to tell about a particular dish. Especially the cheese samosa and fish Koliwada was called out loud by my guests.
4. Organizers: Very hospitable, flexible, honest, transparent of what can be done, what can be improved, setup etc.

Just Steps Away from Churchgate Station – Shri Sunderbai Hall

Located barely a **2-minute walk from Churchgate Railway Station**, **Shri Sunderbai Hall** is one of those places you might pass by without noticing, but once you’ve discovered it, you’ll find yourself coming back again and again.

This **spacious and well-maintained hall** has become a go-to venue for a variety of **pop-up exhibitions, sales, and events** that attract crowds from all over Mumbai. Whether it’s a **mega book fair**, a **trendy clothing and handicraft pop-up**, or a **home decor and lifestyle sale**, there’s always something interesting happening here.

One of the standout features of Sunderbai Hall is its **prime location**—literally a stone’s throw away from Churchgate station, making it easily accessible by train, cab, or even on foot if you're already in the Fort/Marine Lines area. The moment you step out of the station, a short walk brings you to this quiet, convenient venue nestled amid the city's hustle.

The hall itself is **quite large and airy**, with enough space to comfortably host multiple stalls without it feeling cramped. Events here are generally **well-organized** with good crowd management, clear signage, and polite staff who ensure everything runs smoothly. There’s always a buzz of activity, but never chaos—an excellent balance!

What’s even better is that most events here are **free to enter** or charge a nominal fee. Perfect for casual browsing or even planned shopping trips, especially if you're into **book bargains, ethnic fashion, artisanal crafts, or curated home goods**.

In a city like Mumbai where space is a premium, **Sunderbai Hall stands out as a reliable and versatile venue** that consistently delivers quality experiences. If you're in the area, keep an eye out—you never know what treasure trove awaits inside.

📍**Location tip:** Exit Churchgate station from the main gate, take a left, and it's right around the corner. Super easy to find!

🗓️**Pro tip:** Check local event listings or posters at the station—there’s always something new happening here!

MVM Banquets is a good place for hosting small functions and its location is truly superb. The hall is convenient and easy for guests to reach. featured_reviews.name: Mihir Rele
featured_reviews.review_text:
Big Name, Huge Disappointment – Proceed with Extreme Caution!
Garware Club House has a massive reputation, but their actions are incredibly small. If you are planning the most important day of your life here, my personal advice is to look elsewhere unless you want to spend your entire wedding drowning in stress.
Here is a breakdown of the reality behind the "big name":
• The Cancellation Trap (The Biggest Drawback): Please read their terms and conditions carefully. They reserve the right to cancel your hall booking at any time—even just 4 days before the wedding! While our wedding was thankfully saved, several weddings near our date were abruptly canceled simply because of a match or event at Wankhede Stadium. You will constantly be on edge.
• Unreliable & Poor Accommodations: You would expect the bride and groom to have a guaranteed space to get ready, but management can cancel your room booking for the most ridiculous reasons. Even if you do get a room, they are not in good condition. The ACs do not work properly, and the staff brushes off complaints with "renovation" excuses. No one listens to your issues, and no one actually cares about your event.
• Decorator Monopoly & Broken Promises: There is a strict monopoly of just two decorators, and their prices are exorbitantly high. Worse, they do not deliver on their commitments. Our grand entry was not executed as promised, guest chairs were missing, and the decorator didn’t even bother setting up a table for our family dinner.
• Hidden Costs & Extortionate Demands: You have to pay explicitly for valet parking. Then, after your event is over, the staff will hound you for extra money, acting as if they provided excellent service. Expect them to brazenly demand anywhere from ₹10,000 to ₹25,000.
• The Only Saving Grace: Swad Catering. The catering team was genuinely good, and the food tasted awesome.
Final Verdict: Save yourself the mental agony. Do not book this hall if you want peace of mind regarding whether your venue will actually be there on your wedding day. If you do consider it, read every single line of the terms and conditions before signing anything!

Worst Wedding Venue Experience – Absolute Mismanagement and Broken Promises

If I could give Sawai Banquet Hall zero stars, I would.

What was supposed to be one of the most important and memorable days of our lives turned into a stressful and frustrating experience because of the venue's complete lack of professionalism, planning, and accountability. The management made countless promises before taking our booking, but when it came time to deliver, they failed on almost every front.

We were explicitly assured that the afternoon event would end by 4:30 PM and that all the venues we had booked Sawai Banquet, Tiara, Ahana, and Vatika  would be fully handed over by 5:30 PM. However, when we arrived at 6:15 PM, the previous event's guests were still vacating the premises. The venue was nowhere close to being ready. Decorations had not been completed, arrangements were unfinished, and there was complete chaos instead of preparation.

The bridal room was another disappointment. The air conditioning was not working, making it extremely uncomfortable for the bride and family members during an already hectic schedule.

The washrooms were dirty, unhygienic, and clearly had not been cleaned properly despite repeated assurances regarding venue cleanliness. For a premium wedding venue, this level of neglect is simply unacceptable.

Several arrangements that were specifically promised during discussions were never provided. Direction boards for the Veg and Non-Veg food sections were missing. The Nikah setup was not arranged as committed. Guests were left confused and inconvenienced due to the lack of basic event coordination.

The situation only worsened during the reception. Even by 8:00 PM, the special reception entry that had been promised was still not ready. Chairs and sofas were covered in dust and looked as though they had not been cleaned before guests arrived. It was embarrassing to host guests under such conditions.

Parking arrangements were another complete failure. We were charged for parking facilities for approximately 30 vehicles and were informed that the venue had a tie-up with Amar Theatre to accommodate additional parking. On the wedding day, we were suddenly informed that the theatre was undergoing demolition and no parking was available. No alternative arrangements were made, leaving our guests to struggle unnecessarily.

What is most disappointing is not just the poor execution, but the complete gap between what was promised and what was delivered. The management seems far more interested in making commitments during the sales process than actually fulfilling them on the event day.

This venue excels at making promises and fails at keeping them.

Our wedding day should have been filled with joy and celebration. Instead, we spent hours dealing with delays, missing arrangements, poor cleanliness, and management failures.

I would strongly advise anyone planning a wedding or major event to avoid Sawai Banquet Hall unless they are prepared for last-minute surprises, broken commitments, and unnecessary stress.

Tall promises. Zero delivery. Zero accountability. Absolutely not recommended.

featured_reviews.review_text: The catering services in Worli at Sunville Banquets are top-notch. Delicious food, generous portions, and professional serving staff made our event stand out.

featured_reviews.name: trisha rane
featured_reviews.review_text:
Thank you Sunville!!!
Had been for my brothers wedding and let me tell you,the place is fabulous. Also the staff and management were courteous and guiding through various services.
Speaking about the food, it was really amazing not just a basic banquet food but it really was taste worthy and presentable.

featured_reviews.review_text: Its a good place to conduct an event or a workshop. Quite spacious and with all required necessities. You can customise and choose the food options at your convenience as they don't have Inhouse food options.

featured_reviews.review_text: This place is for conferences and marriage and reception purposes.The food here is amazing. Staff here is well mannered and they know their services very well.Great ambiance with beautiful interior.

featured_reviews.review_text: Good place for meetings. Food is good quality as it comes from same kitchen as copper chimney restaurant. Pain point is extra charges for hall rental despite charging 1250 per head with taxes.
